offering_description.value: The company operates cable television networks and subscription streaming services for viewers. It produces and acquires series and films, distributes them through its own services and third-party outlets, and sells advertising to brands and agencies.

primary_products.value: scripted television series; unscripted television programs; independent feature films; home entertainment releases

primary_services.value: cable television programming; subscription video streaming; television and streaming advertising; film distribution; television production

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pay-TV operators, streaming platforms, advertisers, media agencies, broadcasters and cinema operators; B2C: Streaming subscribers and buyers or renters of films and television programs

end_markets.value: pay television; subscription streaming; media advertising; theatrical exhibition; home entertainment

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: Carriage rights for television channels and exhibition rights for series and films; advertising: Commercial placements across television networks and ad-supported streaming services; subscription: Recurring access to general entertainment and genre-focused streaming services; product sales: Physical and digital home entertainment releases; transaction or usage fees: Individual on-demand rentals of films and television programs
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; advertising; subscription; product sales; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Packages original and acquired programming into channels and sells advertising to brands and agencies; software / platform: Delivers licensed and original programming to subscribers through owned streaming services; distributor: Places acquired and internally produced series and films with broadcasters, streaming platforms, cinemas and home entertainment outlets; OEM / manufacturer: Develops and produces original television programming for its own networks and third-party buyers
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; distributor; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada, with television and streaming operations in parts of Europe and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Cable networks, general entertainment and genre streaming, television production and independent film distribution

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Cable, satellite and internet pay-TV operators, third-party streaming storefronts, cinemas and digital video retailers; online: Company-operated streaming websites and apps; direct sales: Advertising sales to brands and agencies and programming sales to media companies; third-party retail: Retailers selling physical home entertainment releases
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; online; direct sales; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FCC accessibility and captioning rules, FTC advertising rules, privacy laws and local audiovisual media requirements

notes: The exact current country footprint of the international channels and streaming services is uncertain.
